# Waybilla Nigeria

> Nigeria's #1 Dedicated Waybill Live Tracking Platform for interstate motor parks and commercial transport companies.

Track and manage interstate parcels sent through major transit lines like Peace Mass, GUO, GIGM, Young Shall Grow, Romchi, and other Nigerian motor parks in real-time.

## Key Features

- **Live Waybill Tracking**: Search and verify transit status of interstate parcels in real-time.
- **Digital Waybills & Receipts**: Secure digital receipts with assigned driver, vehicle details, and route progress.
- **Local Persistence**: Full account histories, tracking updates, and custom profile details securely persisted.

## Main Entry Points

- [Waybill Search Console](https://waybilla.com.ng/) - Real-time tracking and live status console.
- [Customer Login & Signup](https://waybilla.com.ng/login/customer) - Customer terminal to view dispatch history and current packages.
- [Staff Terminal Login](https://waybilla.com.ng/login/staff) - Loading officer portal to register and update parcels.
- [Company Admin Portal](https://waybilla.com.ng/login/company) - Transport line admin dashboard to monitor parks, staff, and drivers.
- [Super Admin Panel](https://waybilla.com.ng/login/admin) - Platform administration, metrics, and billing settings.
